about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (Obadiah) is the prophecy against Edom, the nation of Esau listed in today’s chapter. It ends with “Saviors shall go up on Mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau, and the kingdom shall be the LORD’s.” The reading from the Apostles (Matthew 2:13–23) brings Esau and Jacob face to face again. Herod, an Idumean (Edomite) king, tries to destroy the newborn King of the Jews, who goes down into Egypt and is called out of Egypt like Israel.
